Name: AudioDuck
Author: xenside
Description: AudioDuck runs as this plugin: per-app ducking while Stream Deck runs. The key pauses or resumes ducking and shows whether it is paused, active or ducking right now. Hold it to open the AudioDuck window with the rules.

Actions.Name: Ducking
Actions.Tooltip: Tap: pause or resume ducking. Hold: open AudioDuck.
